statement: A magazine crew ranked the 2013 KX450F first of six: 55.05 hp at 9,000 rpm and 239 lb, with a strong, well-delivered powerband, launch control, adjustable footpegs and plug-in maps. Against it: quirky handling, weak brakes, a loud muffler, a doubtful clutch and a bulky feel.

A second magazine also named the 2013 KX450F the clear winner on both engine and handling: the broadest, smoothest power and the most compliant ride over small bumps, and no tester bottomed either end in two days. It was the loudest bike and the front can feel vague mid-turn. Dropping 2-3 psi from the air fork helped in tight turns, and the soft map made it more forgiving.

topic: KYB shock spring part numbers and rates
statement: KYB's 2021 Genuine Parts Catalog lists shock springs for the Kawasaki KX450 2009-2014 from 36 to 62 N/mm.

source.name: 2021 KYB Genuine Parts Catalog (Technical Touch USA, official KYB distributor), pp. 146-147
